observations: body L1: a small triangular mark is printed below the 0 of the line number 10 of «١٧٥»; not transcribed.
body L15, L32: «فهو» (L15) and «هو» (L32) are printed with elongated joins (kashīda), not transcribed.

body L15, L31, L32, L36: «للحاصّة» (L15) and «حَاصَّة» (L36) are printed without the dot of khāʾ; the word is «خاصّة», printed with the dot in «خاصة» (L31) and «الخاصّة» (L32). Transcribed as printed.
body L20: the m of «respondentem» is printed broken, its first stroke apart from the rest, so that it resembles «in».
body L22: the hyphen of «argu-» is printed as a short point.
body L24: the 0 of the quotation, between «من» and «الى قف» (from 0 to 180), is the zero sign of the tables, as in S07.
body L31, L36: «24,r.–v.» (L31) and «at–Tahānawī» (L36) are printed with an en dash (5.8 and 5.5 points), as «at–Tahānawī» on p. 324.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
